coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Three of seven ground-truth items are matched (43%): a train/validation/test splitting protocol, ACF-based cycle-length selection, and planned ACF visualizations. These matches concern the relevant variable information, although the proposed experiment is substantially broader.
coverage.design_error_analysis: ETTh1 is included but is not held constant; eight datasets are proposed. StandardScaler normalization and statsmodels.tsa.stattools.acf are not specified. Varying the number of ACF lags is not clearly specified: candidate-set changes and window truncation are not necessarily equivalent. The primary optimum is defined by validation MSE rather than the highest autocorrelation peak.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion describing an ACF plot with periodic peaks or recommending an optimal CycleNet cycle length is provided.
